description: Read the current state of a cart created with create_cart: status, lines, totals, selected shipping, when it was previewed, its order if one exists and a pointer to get_trust_receipt. Read-only: it changes nothing and does not open any approval. Use it to resume a purchase; for UCP checkouts use ucp_get_checkout. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

cart_id.description: The cart id returned by create_cart (the checkout session id, a valid UUID).

name: get_checkout_state
